subject.title: fix(ui): show friendly session identifiers instead of raw open_id/session keys [AI-assisted]

question: Should exec/plugin approval dialogs replace raw session keys with friendly labels, or show friendly context only alongside the exact raw session key?
rationale: Approval rows are operator decision context, and current main preserves the exact session target while this PR can collapse some typed session keys to generic labels.

options.title: Show Friendly Plus Exact Raw Key
options.body: Approval rows would become readable without losing the precise session target needed for allow/deny decisions.

options.title: Keep Raw Approval Keys Only
options.body: Approval rows would preserve current safety behavior while this PR is limited to low-risk activity/session display surfaces.

options.title: Defer Approval Formatting
options.body: Approval formatting would wait for the broader session-label precedence work so all surfaces share one rule.

recommendation.title: Show Friendly Plus Exact Raw Key
recommendation.body: Approval rows would become readable without losing the precise session target needed for allow/deny decisions.

likelyOwner.reason: The approval UI surface was introduced in the gateway-routed exec approval work and is the most security-sensitive touched path.
